proposals.title: Proposal Seven — Stockholder Proposal Regarding Public Policy Committee
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Company to establish a Public Policy Committee to oversee policies on human rights, environment, domestic and foreign governmental regulations, and international relations affecting the business.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding a public policy committee.

proposals.title: Proposal Eight — Stockholder Proposal Regarding Simple Majority Voting Provisions in Governing Documents
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to eliminate supermajority voting requirements in the charter and bylaws and replace them with a simple majority of votes cast for and against.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal regarding simple majority voting.
